newsitem.title: BELGIUM: No movement expected on European company statute.
newsitem.headline: No movement expected on European company statute.

text.p: The Internal Market Council is unlikely to make any progress on Tuesday on the proposal for a European company statute, EU officials said on Tuesday.
The Council is likely to limit itself to hearing a state of play report by Internal Market Commissioner Mario Monti.

The main news he has to report is the setting up of a special high level group headed by former Commissioner Etienne Davignon which will examine exactly how the 25-year-old proposal can be moved forward, the officials said.
